description: If the method that filters a batch of record events down to those a principal may read were changed to require one more mandatory argument describing why the filtering is requested, which production call sites and which tests would need to change? Distinguish direct callers from places affected only indirectly.
anchor_note: non-bug task: root_cause_symbols holds the anchor (entry point / changed symbol); RC metrics are reported for category A only

tests: No spec found that calls RecordEventPermissionsService.filterReadableEvents (grep over src and test). src/engine/permissions/internal/combine/utils/__tests__/filter-readable-events.util.spec.ts tests a different, same-named util and is NOT affected.

oracle_edit.note: Adds a required property to the argument type; tsc then reports a missing-property error at every direct call site. Run: npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/twenty-server/tsconfig.json (not run by the miner: build tooling forbidden).

alternatives: Renaming the method (instead of adding a field) would give the same direct set; a recent commit 36c184849d (2026-11-06) did rename record event permission methods to filter* (#29862), showing this API is actively churned.
